translations.web: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
translations.bsb: He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.
translations.kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
translations.asv: And he led them safely, so that they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
